senses.gloss:
f. (-का)
The introductory stanza to a song, forming afterwards the burthen of each verse.
E.
धू to agitate, अक Uṇādi aff.

m. (-नः)
A title of AGNI.
E.
धू to agitate, affix युच्.

n. (-त्रं)
A sort of fan made of deer skin, and used especially to excite a sacrificial fire.
E.
धू to agitate, इत्र affix; also धवित्र.
